items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Five section.card blocks with h2 '1. Thông tin cá nhân' ... '5. Giấy tờ', fields stacked in space-y-6 max-w-xl; every control has a label.lbl above it (docType select has sr-only label but sits beside an upload button). Placeholders are only example values. Minor: Họ/Tên and Tỉnh/Mã bưu chính share a row (each pair reads as one value).

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required labels carry '*' (span aria-hidden) plus aria-required; header states '* Bắt buộc'; optional fields (Ngày cấp CCCD, Mã bưu chính, Phụ cấp, MST, BHXH) are unmarked.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Widths good: date w-40, postal w-28, taxCode w-56, CCCD w-56; type=email and type=date used. But phone and ecPhone are plain text inputs with inputmode="tel", not type="tel".

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: #draftBtn 'Lưu nháp' handler only calls setSaving and shows 'Đã lưu nháp' toast; no check() call.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: div.sticky.bottom-0 with 'Hủy', 'Lưu nháp', 'Tạo nhân viên' (visible in first-viewport screenshot); saveBtn only disabled during setSaving(true).

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: el.addEventListener('blur', validateField); submit runs check for all FIELDS, renderSummary(list) builds '<n> trường cần chú ý' with links that focus the field, then targetEl(list[0][0]).focus().

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: window beforeunload handler when dirty; plus #leaveDlg alertdialog via guard() on Cancel and in-app nav links.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Text 'Chấp nhận PDF, JPG, PNG, tối đa 10 MB mỗi tệp'; docsTable rows with 'Xóa' button (aria-label 'Xóa <name>') and undo toast; #uploadBtn is a real button that triggers the hidden file input; rejects bad type/size with message.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: toast('Đã tạo nhân viên ' + fullName() + ' (NV-0248). Thư mời đã gửi tới ...') inside container with role="status" aria-live="polite".

notes: Audit score 100, no violations. No template tells: flat white/slate, 4-6px radii, no gradients/glass/emoji/KPI tiles/promo card. Only failing item is the phone fields lacking type=tel. Extra observations: native date inputs show mm/dd/yyyy in a vi page; summary only appears at 3+ errors (fine); form is wrapped in a card per section with a left anchor nav (not card-in-card).
